name: bullet-chart
purpose: Accessible SVG bullet chart: compact horizontal measures against a target and up to three qualitative ranges (for example poor / satisfactory / good) on a shared value axis. Each row has shaded range bands in neutral shades, a measure bar, and a target tick; each measure bar is keyboard-reachable (Up/Down) and its name reads the value, the target, and the named range, so meaning never depends on shading. A generated summary counts measures at or above target, and a data table lists value, target, and range per measure.
whenToUse: Key performance indicators against targets in a dashboard, with a qualitative scale.
Replacing gauges and meters with a compact, comparable row layout.
whenNotToUse: Measures on very different scales (all rows share one value axis): use one chart per scale or Stat Card.
Trends over time: use Line Chart or Sparkline.
A single value against a maximum without target or ranges: use Progress Bar or Gauge.
responsive: Width follows the container (ResizeObserver); height is the height option, divided evenly between rows (bands at most 40 px tall). Measure labels take up to 35% of the width and are truncated with an ellipsis; the full text stays in the accessible names, tooltip, and table. Reflows at 320 CSS px.
rtl: direction rtl mirrors the value axis (bars grow leftward from zero), moves measure labels to the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.
theme: Ranges are three neutral shades mixed from color-text over color-surface (22%, 13%, 6%; darkest first), not palette colors. Measure bars use one palette slot (color option, default color-chart-1) with a color-surface separator; the target tick is color-text. Gridlines color-chart-grid, axes color-chart-axis, measure labels color-text (medium weight). Forced colors use Canvas with GrayText outlines for ranges, CanvasText for targets and labels, and Highlight for focus.
timezone: Not applicable (measures are text and numbers).
security: All text (title, description, labels, values, tooltip, table) is set with textContent; SVG is built with createElementNS. Colors are CSS classes; the height and the tooltip position are written through the CSSOM (style.setProperty). No innerHTML, no style attributes, no inline handlers: works under style-src without unsafe-inline and require-trusted-types-for.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; no persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.metric: BulletChart.create, 30 measures with targets and ranges, including the first render
budgets.budget: < 30 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: Up to about 30 measures per chart (each row is one focusable bar, up to three range bands, a target tick, and a label); increase height with the number of rows.

limitations: Horizontal rows only; all measures share one value axis.
At most three qualitative ranges per measure; the first starts at the axis minimum.
One color for all measure bars; no legend.
A value above the last range end reads as the last range.
The legend, patterns, and hiddenSeries options are accepted (shared chart options) but have no visible effect.
unsupported: Vertical bullet charts, per-measure axes, or a comparative (second) measure bar.
antiPatterns: Mixing measures of different units or magnitudes in one chart.
Unnamed ranges: pass rangeLabels so each row reads "Good" instead of "Range 3".
Using palette colors to signal good and bad (ranges are deliberately neutral).
